mapper.select: SELECT connected_id FROM user WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT a.id AS id, a.company AS company, a.number AS number, MAX(ar.transaction_date) AS lastRecordDate FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_record ar ON ar.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY a.id, a.company, a.number ORDER BY a.id

SELECT c.id AS id, c.company AS company, c.number AS number, MAX(cr.used_date) AS lastRecordDate FROM card c LEFT JOIN card_record cr ON cr.card_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.id, c.company, c.number ORDER BY c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO account_record ( account_id, source_key, transaction_date, transaction_time, out_amount, in_amount, after_transaction_balance, description1, description2, description3, description4, raw_data ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{sourceKey}, #{transactionDate}, #{transactionTime}, #{outAmount}, #{inAmount}, #{afterTransactionBalance}, #{description1}, #{description2}, #{description3}, #{description4}, CAST(#{rawData} AS JSON) )

INSERT IGNORE INTO card_record ( card_id, source_key, used_date, used_time, store_name, used_amount, cancel_yn, cancel_amount, raw_data ) VALUES ( #{cardId}, #{sourceKey}, #{usedDate}, #{usedTime}, #{storeName}, #{usedAmount}, #{cancelYn}, #{cancelAmount}, CAST(#{rawData} AS JSON) )
